facts.business: Evexia Lifecare Limited is engaged in trading of pharmaceutical and healthcare products.

auditor.name: M/s. Tejas K. Soni and Company
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Adverse opinion due to material misstatements: lack of proper fixed asset register, no impairment assessment on investments of Rs 71,130.85 lakh in loss-making subsidiaries, no expected credit loss assessment on trade receivables of Rs 2,943.89 lakh with significant credit risk, FCCBs not recognized at amortized cost or revalued per Ind AS, trade payables of Rs 5,116.89 lakh aged beyond three years with cash of only Rs 9.04 lakh and no liquidity risk disclosures.

key_risks: Material misstatements in financial statements leading to adverse audit opinion
Investments in subsidiaries of Rs 71,130.85 lakh not assessed for impairment despite losses and ceased operations
Trade receivables of Rs 2,943.89 lakh with significant credit risk not assessed for expected credit loss
FCCBs not accounted per Ind AS 109/21/32, impact unknown
Trade payables of Rs 5,116.89 lakh aged beyond three years with minimal cash (Rs 9.04 lakh) and no liquidity risk disclosures
Operating profit margin declined from 4.64% to 3.62% due to purchase costs rising faster than sales realization
